title: On Sex, Evolution, and the Multiplicative Weights Update Algorithm
abstract: arXiv:1502.05056v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We consider a recent innovative theory by Chastain et al. on the role of sex in evolution [PNAS'14]. In short, the theory suggests that the evolutionary process of gene recombination implements the celebrated multiplicative weights updates algorithm (MWUA). They prove that the population dynamics induced by sexual reproduction can be precisely modeled by genes that use MWUA as their learning strategy in a particular coordination game. The result holds in the environments of \emph{weak selection}, under the assumption that the population frequencies remain a product distribution.   We revisit the theory, eliminating both the requirement of weak selection and any assumption on the distribution of the population. Removing the assumption of product distributions is crucial, since as we show, this assumption is inconsistent with the population dynamics. translated_title: 论性别、进化与乘性权重更新算法
translated_abstract: 我们重新审视了Chastain等人最近提出的一个关于性在进化中作用的创新理论 [PNAS'14]。简而言之，该理论表明基因重组的进化过程实现了著名的乘性权重更新算法（MWUA）。他们证明了由有性生殖引发的种群动态可以被精确地建模为：基因在一种特定的协调博弈中采用MWUA作为其学习策略。该结果在弱选择的环境下成立，且需假设种群频率始终保持乘积分布。我们重新审视了这一理论，同时消除了弱选择的要求以及对种群分布的任何假设。去除乘积分布假设至关重要，因为正如我们所证明的，该假设与种群动态本身是不相容的。我们证明了由种群动态所诱导的边缘等位基因分布……
tldr: 该论文强化了性进化理论，证明有性生殖实现乘性权重更新算法（MWUA）这一结论无需弱选择条件，也无需乘积分布假设，并指出乘积分布假设实际上与种群动态不相容。
